note: How the FX2's 8-bit live-view JPEG relates to exposure. 'status' says how much each number is trusted. The grey card test (Step 4) replaces the guesses with measurements.

status.grey_level: DERIVED 2026-10-17: measured black (10.0, lens cap) + measured levels per stop (20.63) + Sony's S-Log3 curve (grey = code 420, black = code 95). Assumes the preview stays linear in S-Log3 code down to black (verified only from level ~82 up). Cross-check: camera meter '0' lands ~1/3 stop below this.
status.levels_per_stop: MEASURED 2026-10-17: 20.63 levels/stop from 7 captures over 6 stops of a matte white wall (ISO 800-51200 and an aperture step), residuals within +/-1.1 levels. Slightly lower (19.5-20) around 82-102.
status.clip_level: MEASURED 2026-10-17: flat clipped wall at ISO 102400 = 221 on all three channels.

camera_meter.status: MEASURED 2026-10-17: +1000 per stop; reads 0 within about 1/3 stop of its target; tops out at 4300.

rec709.status: APPROXIMATE: BT.709 curve. Camera profiles like S-Cinetone differ; only used when not shooting log.
